summary: Ledipasvir carries the Food and Drug Administration's strongest warning because hepatitis B, a viral liver infection, can reactivate in patients who have both hepatitis C and hepatitis B. [3] Due to this risk of reactivation and flare-ups, all patients should be tested for past or present hepatitis B before starting treatment, and co-infected patients must be monitored during and after therapy. [3] Additionally, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated medium risk scores of 61 for the liver and 52 for the heart. [M]
